intro: Canvas Scraps are remnants of tough woven fabric carried by human invaders and centaur tribes encroaching upon Durotar. In Razor Hill, aging veteran Furl Scornbrow collects these salvaged swatches to stitch useful travel sacks for fresh Horde recruits.

p: Canvas is not a fabric native to the rough hide-working traditions of the Orcs, but it is abundant among Durotar's enemies. The Kul Tiras marines and sailors entrenched along the eastern shoreline carry heavy canvas gear and sailcloth remnants from their naval excursions. Further inland, the roaming Kolkar centaur repurpose scraps of coarse cloth looted from supply caravans and past conflicts. Defeating these hostiles yields durable remnants that can be salvaged from their camps and gear.

Perched atop the Razor Hill watchtower, veteran Furl Scornbrow keeps an eye out for invaders while turning his hands to useful labor. Though past his fighting prime, the old warrior repurposes salvaged enemy fabric into sturdy carrying bags for younger soldiers. By turning the materials of Kul Tiras and the Kolkar against them, Furl equips the new generation of defenders fighting to secure the Horde's borders.
